name: dev.elci/tools
title: elci.dev developer tools
description: 51 free developer tools: JSON, YAML, CSV, Base64, JWT, hashes, UUIDs, regex, formatters and more.

tools.name: color_convert
tools.description:
Convert a hex color to RGB and HSL CSS strings. Accepts 3- or 6-digit hex, with or without "#".

Returns: Object with hex (normalised, lowercase), rgb ("rgb(r, g, b)") and hsl ("hsl(h, s%, l%)") strings.

tools.name: css_gradient
tools.description:
Build a CSS linear or radial gradient declaration from color stops.

Returns: Object with value (the gradient function) and css (a ready "background: ...;" declaration).

angle.description: Angle in degrees for linear gradients (ignored for radial).

stops.description: 2 to 8 color stops. Position is a percentage from 0 to 100; stops are sorted by position.

tools.name: box_shadow
tools.description:
Build a CSS box-shadow declaration with offsets, blur, spread, color and opacity.

Returns: Object with value (the shadow list) and css (a ready "box-shadow: ...;" declaration).

tools.name: cubic_bezier
tools.description:
Build a CSS cubic-bezier() timing function from a preset or four control values.

Returns: Object with css ("cubic-bezier(x1, y1, x2, y2)") and the effective x1, y1, x2, y2.

preset.description: Named preset; overrides x1..y2 when given.

x1.description: First control point x. Clamped to 0..1 (CSS requires it).

x2.description: Second control point x. Clamped to 0..1.

tools.name: cidr_calculate
tools.description:
Calculate an IPv4 subnet from CIDR notation: network, broadcast, netmask, wildcard, host range and host counts.

Returns: Object with network, broadcast, netmask, wildcard, firstHost, lastHost, totalHosts, usableHosts and prefixLength.

tools.name: chmod_convert
tools.description:
Convert a Unix octal file mode (e.g. 755) into symbolic form (rwxr-xr-x), the chmod command and a per-class permission breakdown. Supports setuid/setgid/sticky with a 4-digit mode.

Returns: Object with octal (normalised), symbolic, command, permissions (owner/group/others read/write/execute) and special (setuid/setgid/sticky).

octal.description: Octal mode of 3 or 4 digits, e.g. "644" or "4755".

tools.name: http_status_lookup
tools.description:
Look up HTTP status codes by number prefix ("40" finds 400-409), name or meaning, optionally limited to one class.

Returns: Object with count and matches: [{ code, name, description }].

query.description: Code prefix, or text from the name or description. Empty returns all codes.

tools.name: dns_lookup
tools.description:
Resolve a DNS record through Cloudflare DNS-over-HTTPS. Makes a network request to cloudflare-dns.com from the caller.

Returns: Object with status (e.g. NOERROR, NXDOMAIN), answers and authority: [{ name, type, ttl, data }].

tools.name: robots_txt_generate
tools.description:
Generate a robots.txt file with allow/disallow rules, optional AI crawler blocks, crawl delay and sitemap lines.

Returns: Object with robotsTxt: the file content.

defaultPolicy.description: "allow" opens the site (except disallowed paths); "block" disallows everything for all crawlers.

disallow.description: Paths to disallow for all crawlers (ignored when defaultPolicy is "block").

crawlDelay.description: Crawl-delay in seconds (some crawlers ignore it; Google does).

tools.name: meta_tags_generate
tools.description:
Generate the <head> meta tags for SEO, Open Graph and Twitter cards. Empty fields are left out.

Returns: Object with html: the tags to paste into <head>.

title.description: Page title (aim for 60 characters or fewer).

description.description: Meta description (aim for 160 characters or fewer).

tools.name: gitignore_generate
tools.description:
Combine language, framework, editor and OS templates into one .gitignore, dropping duplicate lines.

Returns: Object with gitignore: the combined file, one "### Name" section per template.

tools.name: crontab_explain
tools.description:
Explain a 5-field cron expression in plain English (minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week).

Returns: Object with the normalised expression and an English description of when it runs.

tools.name: timestamp_convert
tools.description:
Convert between Unix timestamps and dates. Give a timestamp (seconds or milliseconds) or a dateTime in a time zone; with neither, converts the current time. Always returns ISO 8601 UTC plus both Unix units.

Returns: Object with iso, unixSeconds, unixMilliseconds, utc, timeZone, formatted (in that zone) and relative ("in 2 days").

dateTime.description: Local date and time in "timeZone", as "YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm" or "YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss" (no zone suffix).

timeZone.description: IANA time zone used for dateTime and for the formatted output.

tools.name: timezone_convert
tools.description:
Convert a date and time from one IANA time zone to another, accounting for daylight saving time.

Returns: Object with utc (ISO), source and target: { timeZone, formatted }.

dateTime.description: Local date and time in sourceZone, as "YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm".

targetZone.description: IANA time zone to convert to.

tools.name: json_format
tools.description:
Format (2-space indent), minify or stringify JSON. Format and minify also expand JSON that is embedded as a string inside the document. Reports the parse error for invalid JSON.

Returns: Object with output: the resulting text.

action.description: "format" pretty-prints, "minify" removes whitespace, "stringify" returns the JSON as an escaped string literal.

tools.name: json_diff
tools.description:
Compare two JSON documents by structure. Key order and whitespace do not count; array order does.

Returns: Object with identical (boolean), added and removed (line counts) and parts: [{ value, added?, removed? }] in document order.

tools.name: jsonpath_query
tools.description:
Evaluate a JSONPath expression against a JSON document. Supports filters ($..book[?(@.price < 10)]) and recursive descent.

Returns: Object with matchCount and matches (always a list, empty when nothing matches).

resultType.description: Return the matched values or the path of each match.

tools.name: json_schema_validate
tools.description:
Validate JSON data against a JSON Schema (draft 4, 7, 2019-09 or 2020-12; "auto" reads $schema and defaults to 2020-12). Lists every error with a JSON Pointer path.

Returns: Object with valid (boolean), draft (the draft used) and errors: [{ path (JSON Pointer, "" for the root), keyword, message }].

schema.description: The JSON Schema, as JSON text.

tools.name: json_to_typescript
tools.description:
Generate TypeScript interfaces from a JSON sample.

Returns: Object with typescript: the interface declarations.

tools.name: yaml_json_convert
tools.description:
Convert between YAML and JSON.

Returns: Object with output: the converted text.

tools.name: csv_json_convert
tools.description:
Convert between CSV (first row is the header) and JSON.

Returns: Object with output: the converted text.

tools.name: json_to_csv
tools.description:
Convert a JSON array of objects (or one object) to CSV. Nested objects become dotted columns (user.name) when flatten is on; arrays stay in one cell as JSON. Columns are every key seen in any row.

Returns: Object with csv (the CSV text, CRLF line endings), columns and rows (counts).

input.description: JSON text: an array of objects, one object, or an array of values.

flatten.description: Turn nested objects into dotted columns instead of JSON text.

tools.name: xml_format
tools.description:
Format or minify XML and check that it is well-formed (single root, matching tags, no unterminated constructs). Does not validate against a schema.

Returns: Object with output: the resulting XML.

action.description: "format" indents, "minify" removes whitespace between tags and comments.

indent.description: Indentation for "format": 2 spaces, 4 spaces or a tab.

tools.name: xml_to_json
tools.description:
Convert XML to JSON. Attributes become "@name", text beside attributes or child elements becomes "#text", repeated elements become arrays, CDATA is text and comments are dropped.

Returns: Object with json: the converted value, keyed by the root element name.

coerce.description: Turn numbers and true/false into JSON numbers and booleans (values with leading zeros stay text).

tools.name: sql_format
tools.description:
Format SQL with upper-cased keywords for a chosen dialect.

Returns: Object with output: the formatted SQL.

tools.name: html_format
tools.description:
Beautify or minify HTML.

Returns: Object with output: the resulting HTML.

tools.name: css_format
tools.description:
Beautify or minify CSS.

Returns: Object with output: the resulting CSS.

tools.name: js_format
tools.description:
Beautify or minify JavaScript.

Returns: Object with output: the resulting JavaScript.

tools.name: base64_encode
tools.description:
Encode text (UTF-8) as Base64, optionally in the URL-safe alphabet (- and _ instead of + and /, no padding).

Returns: Object with output: the Base64 text.

tools.name: base64_decode
tools.description:
Decode Base64 text (standard or URL-safe alphabet) to a UTF-8 string.

Returns: Object with output: the decoded text.

tools.name: url_encode
tools.description:
Percent-encode text for use inside a URL (encodeURIComponent).

Returns: Object with output: the encoded text.

tools.name: url_decode
tools.description:
Decode percent-encoded text (decodeURIComponent). Malformed sequences are reported as an error.

Returns: Object with output: the decoded text.

tools.name: number_base_convert
tools.description:
Convert a non-negative integer between binary, octal, decimal and hexadecimal, exactly, for any length.

Returns: Object with binary, octal, decimal and hex (uppercase) strings.

value.description: The number, using only digits valid for inputBase.

tools.name: text_binary_convert
tools.description:
Convert text to its UTF-8 bytes written in binary, hex, decimal or octal, or decode such bytes back to text. Decoding accepts spaces, commas, 0x prefixes or one unseparated run.

Returns: Object with output: the encoded bytes or the decoded text.

input.description: Text to encode, or bytes to decode.

direction.description: Encode text to bytes, or decode bytes to text.

separator.description: Between encoded bytes (decimal always uses a space).

tools.name: jwt_decode
tools.description:
Decode a JWT: header, payload and signature, with iat/exp as ISO 8601 UTC and an "expired" flag. Does NOT verify the signature.

Returns: Object with header, payload, signature, issuedAt, expiresAt (ISO UTC), expired and signatureVerified (always false).

tools.name: qr_code_svg
tools.description:
Generate a QR code as an SVG string.

Returns: Object with svg: the SVG markup.

errorLevel.description: Error correction level: L (7%), M (15%), Q (25%) or H (30%).

tools.name: case_convert
tools.description:
Convert text between naming and letter cases (camelCase, snake_case, kebab-case, Title Case, ...). Words are split on spaces, underscores, hyphens and case boundaries (XMLParser becomes XML Parser).

Returns: Object with output: the converted text.

tools.name: slugify_text
tools.description:
Turn a title into a URL slug: lowercase, accents removed, runs of other characters become single hyphens.

Returns: Object with slug.

tools.name: word_count
tools.description:
Count words, characters, sentences and paragraphs and estimate reading time at 200 words per minute.

Returns: Object with words, characters, charactersNoSpaces, sentences, paragraphs and readingTimeMinutes (rounded up).

tools.name: regex_test
tools.description:
Test a JavaScript regular expression against a string and list every match with its index and capture groups.

Returns: Object with matchCount and matches: [{ match, index, groups (null for unmatched), namedGroups? }].

flags.description: Flags: any of d g i m s u y, each at most once. With "g" all matches are returned, otherwise the first.

tools.name: text_diff
tools.description:
Compare two texts line by line.

Returns: Object with identical, added and removed (line counts) and parts: [{ value, added?, removed? }] in order.

tools.name: lorem_ipsum
tools.description:
Generate lorem ipsum placeholder text. The first output always starts with the classic "Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet" opening; the rest is random.

Returns: Object with text.

tools.name: hash_text
tools.description:
Compute MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-384 and SHA-512 of a UTF-8 string, as lowercase hex. MD5 and SHA-1 are not safe for security purposes.

Returns: Object with md5, sha1, sha256, sha384 and sha512 hex strings.

tools.name: bcrypt
tools.description:
Hash a password with bcrypt, or verify a password against a bcrypt hash. Higher cost is slower: each +1 doubles the time.

Returns: For hash: { hash }. For verify: { match: boolean }.

mode.description: "hash" creates a hash, "verify" checks a password against a hash.

hash.description: The bcrypt hash to check, for "verify".

tools.name: jwt_encode
tools.description:
Create and sign a JWT with HMAC (HS256, HS384 or HS512). Add "iat"/"exp" yourself if you want them.

Returns: Object with token: the signed JWT.

payload.description: Claims as a JSON object, e.g. {"sub": "42"}.

secret.description: HMAC secret. Never send a production secret to any tool you do not control.

tools.name: jwt_verify
tools.description:
Verify a JWT signature: HS256/384/512 with the shared secret, RS*, PS* or ES* with a public key (PEM "BEGIN PUBLIC KEY", JWK or JWKS). Also reports whether exp/nbf make it expired or not yet valid. A public key is never accepted as an HMAC secret.

Returns: Object with valid (signature check), algorithm, header, payload, expired and notYetValid (booleans, absent without exp/nbf), and expiresAt / issuedAt / notBefore as ISO dates.

key.description: HMAC secret, or the public key as PEM, JWK or JWKS JSON. Never send a production secret to any tool you do not control.

secretEncoding.description: How an HMAC secret is written.

tools.name: password_generate
tools.description:
Generate a random password with a cryptographically secure generator. Characters are drawn uniformly from the selected sets; each set is not guaranteed to appear.

Returns: Object with password.

tools.name: uuid_generate
tools.description:
Generate UUIDs: v1 (time + node), v4 (random), v6 (reordered v1) or v7 (time-ordered, good for database keys).

Returns: Object with uuids: a list of UUID strings.

tools.name: ulid_generate
tools.description:
Generate ULIDs: 26-character, lexicographically sortable identifiers with a millisecond timestamp.

Returns: Object with ulids: a list of ULID strings.

monotonic.description: Guarantee increasing order within the batch when timestamps tie.

time.description: Timestamp in milliseconds since the Unix epoch (default: now).

tools.name: random_numbers
tools.description:
Generate random integers in an inclusive range with a cryptographically secure generator, optionally all distinct.

Returns: Object with numbers: a list of integers.

tools.name: self_signed_certificate
tools.description:
Generate a self-signed X.509 certificate and RSA key pair (PEM). For local development only. Slow for large key sizes: 4096 bits can take many seconds. Always signed with SHA-256.

Returns: Object with privateKey, publicKey and certificate (PEM strings) and fingerprint.

commonName.description: Common name; also used as the DNS subject alternative name.

algorithm.description: Signature hash. Only sha256 is honoured by the underlying library.
